owner_gated_inputs.bootstrap_law: dedicated CODEOWNERS-only ordinary two-parent PR merge to main with independent djordi10 exact-head approval before merge; this bootstrap merge is the literal first parent of the source merge

source_pr.must_not_contain: generation-2 receipt or generation-2 receipt evidence
source_pr.base_codeowners: first parent equals the recorded reviewed CODEOWNERS-bootstrap merge and contains the exact sole-owner CODEOWNERS bytes
source_pr.merge_law: ordinary two-parent merge; second parent and merge tree equal the exact reviewed and CI-passing source head

receipt_pr.terminal_provider_law: ordinary two-parent PR merge to live main; first parent equals the receipt-declared source merge; second parent and merge tree equal the exact independently djordi10-reviewed and CI-passing receipt head; review, matching Actions workflow, and integration-bound check complete before merge; provider and Git merge times match

main_sequence_law: NO_INTERVENING_MAIN_MERGE: reviewed CODEOWNERS bootstrap merge -> reviewed corrective source merge -> reviewed append-only receipt merge

clean_runner_law.source: fresh canonical HTTPS clone at the exact two-parent source merge; detached clean checkout; no local clone optimization, tags, replace refs, alternates, shallow history, submodules, inherited venv, system site-packages, or package cache
clean_runner_law.semantic_proof: exact closed 50-file namespace; source/tree/workflow/contract bytes; constrained installed-package inventory; exact argv/env/cwd/chronology/raw streams/return codes; identical seed inventories with no skip/xfail/xpass/failure/error; reproducible artifacts; safe-hold config; revert-to-first-parent rollback tree
clean_runner_law.authentication: the two distinct receipt Ed25519 signers authenticate the ordered closed manifest and every clean-runner byte; no self-reported hardware ephemerality claim is accepted

receipt_premerge_law.receipt_pr: open and unmerged on main; base SHA equals the receipt-declared source merge; head SHA equals the exact clean receipt head; latest decisive independent CODEOWNER review is APPROVED; latest relevant GitHub Actions workflow and integration-bound test-and-verify check succeed
receipt_premerge_law.main_ruleset: fresh live fixed-endpoint match with visible empty bypass_actors, unchanged canary ref, and authenticated failed canary rule suite
receipt_premerge_law.tag_ruleset: committed canonical capture is externally pinned, active, exact-tag scoped, has only update and deletion rules, has visible empty bypass_actors, and was updated before receipt observed_at_us
receipt_premerge_law.result: OK_PREMERGE only; cannot close B00R because receipt merge and physical annotated anchor do not yet exist

closure_anchor.tag_ruleset_chronology: created_at <= updated_at < receipt observed_at_us <= emitted_at_us < receipt provider merged_at
closure_anchor.tag_ruleset_capture_phase: install, capture, and externally pin before the final receipt head is signed, reviewed, or merged
closure_anchor.terminal_receipt_pr: required positive provider PR number, revalidated live
closure_anchor.b01c_base: exact generation-2 receipt merge commit named by the validated anchor
